title: Great Circle Distance Batch Calculator | Center for Geographic Analysis
content: # Great Circle Distance Batch Calculator. This tool for ArcGIS version 10 allows for the input of an unlimited number of origin/destination latitude, longitude pairs in CSV format, and calculates the distance between the origin and destination for each pair using the great circle distance formula (the shortest distance between 2 points on earth). Created by CGA intern Brian Bettenhausen.

title: Great Circle Calculator
content: # Great Circle Calculator. We will teach you how to calculate the great circle distance between two points, both on a sphere and a more realistic shape for Earth. ## What is the great circle? Introduction to the great circle between two points. Before the definitions, though, it's better to introduce the situations in which we will test our great circle calculator! The **great circle** is the closed circle deriving from the intersection of a sphere and a plane passing through the center of the sphere. The same holds if we consider the great circle passing through a point on the sphere's surface. When considering two points and the great circle between them, we can define (and calculate) the distance between them on the great circle: there are **two possible values**:. The great circle is the circle containing the **shortest possible path** between two points on a sphere. Earlier, we said that the great circle distance we calculate between two points is the **shortest possible path**.
